ideas.pitch: A high-performance, drop-in C++ module implementing optimized multi-hop dynamic node routing for decentralized edge meshes under high packet-loss conditions.
ideas.problem_statement: Dynamic node routing in decentralized mesh networks
ideas.title: MeshRoute-C: Latency-Aware Dynamic Node Routing in C++
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core requirement of C++ and embedded systems contributions with hard systems engineering, directly matching the hackathon's focus on robust edge infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: An open-source telemetry dashboard and optimization simulator for monitoring packet delivery ratio, congestion, and self-healing topologies in mesh networks.
ideas.problem_statement: Swarm network optimization and testing infrastructure
ideas.title: SwarmSim-Visualizer: Real-Time Node Health and Swarm Optimization Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the lack of robust testing tools for decentralized networks, giving judges a clear, visual interface to evaluate swarm behavior.

ideas.pitch: A rigorous stress-testing framework designed to inject malicious and malformed packets into edge mesh daemons, ensuring memory safety and fault-tolerance.
ideas.problem_statement: Testing and documentation to build robust edge infrastructure
ideas.title: EdgeTest-Fuzz: Automated Protocol Fuzzing and Stress-Test Harness for Mesh Nodes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the testing category requested in the GitHub issues, which organizers value heavily for production-ready open-source infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: An ultra-low footprint serialization and transport wrapper tailored for microcontroller-class mesh nodes running custom routing protocols.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world issues in dynamic node routing and swarm network optimization
ideas.title: Mesh-ZeroMQ: Lightweight Zero-Allocation Transport Layer for Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases low-level systems programming capability which stands out in an event specifically targeting C++ enthusiasts and IoT builders.

ideas.pitch: An automated documentation pipeline that parses C++ header files and packet definitions to generate interactive protocol diagrams and developer guides.
ideas.problem_statement: Documentation to build robust edge infrastructure
ideas.title: DocMesh: Automated API Reference and Protocol Specification Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the explicit documentation contribution category while maintaining technical depth by parsing C++ abstract syntax trees directly.
